## This week

Reasoning models internalize the caller-side procedures of W2: thinking budgets as a billable resource, the training problem (no process labels), STaR bootstrapping, reinforcement learning fundamentals (policy, reward, RLHF vs. RLVR), and DeepSeek-R1 with GRPO.

## Lab

Thinking-budget measurement: vary a reasoning model's budget on a fixed evalset and plot the accuracy–cost curve (published before class).

Run it in Colab: download the notebook, go to [colab.research.google.com](https://colab.research.google.com) → Upload, paste your API key into the setup cell ([API Setup](api-setup.qmd)), and run top to bottom.
